T: Death is only the beginning. Of dinner.
D: An adventurer, a librarian and her brother wake a cursed high priest in the lost city of Hamunaptra.
P: Serve the snacks when Evie knocks over every shelf in the Cairo library.
S: Soaked chickpeas blitzed with onion, garlic, parsley, coriander and cumin, shaped into balls and fried at 180C, with tahini sauce.
the scarab beetles swarming under the sand
Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter, dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed pistachios.
the riverboat up the Nile before it burns

Eggplant charred black over a flame until smoky, whipped with tahini, garlic and lemon, topped with pomegranate and olive oil, with warm pita. Char 2 eggplants directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning, until black and collapsed. Cool, peel and drain in a sieve for 10 minutes. Mash with 3 tbsp tahini, a crushed garlic clove, the juice of a lemon and salt. Spread on a plate, drizzle with olive oil and scatter with pomegranate seeds and parsley. Serve with 4 warm pita breads.
M: Lamb shoulder braised slowly with cumin, cinnamon and tomato until it pulls apart, over spiced rice with toasted almonds, crispy onions and yoghurt. Brown a 1.5kg lamb shoulder, add a sliced onion, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, a can of crushed tomatoes and 500ml water, then cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Fry 2 sliced onions until dark and crisp. Cook 300g basmati with a cinnamon stick and 2 cardamom pods. Pull the lamb apart into its sauce. Serve over the rice with toasted almonds, crispy onions and yoghurt.
the camp at the dig site
Lentils, rice and macaroni layered with a spicy tomato sauce, crispy fried onions and chickpeas.
W: Book of the Dead honey pastries
the black Book of the Dead
Filo layered with butter, walnuts and cinnamon, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, soaked in honey syrup.
K: Desert ruby hibiscus and lime cooler
the long desert ride to Hamunaptra

Dried hibiscus steeped with sugar, ginger and cinnamon until deep ruby red, chilled and poured over ice with lime and mint. Steep 30g dried hibiscus flowers in 1L just-boiled water with 100g sugar, a few slices of ginger and a cinnamon stick for 15 minutes. Strain into a jug and chill well. Fill four tall glasses with ice, pour in the hibiscus and add a good squeeze of lime to each. Finish with mint sprigs.

s.how: Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight, then blitz with a chopped onion, garlic, parsley and a teaspoon of cumin. Shape into balls and fry at 180C until deep golden. Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth and drizzle over to serve.

s.note: the scarab beetles swarming under the sand
s.how: Slit 16 medjool dates and remove the stones. Fill each with a teaspoon of almond butter and press closed. Dip halfway into melted dark chocolate and roll the chocolate end in crushed pistachios. Set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.

m.note: the camp at the dig site
m.how: Cook 200g brown lentils, 200g rice and 200g macaroni separately. Simmer a can of crushed tomatoes with garlic, chilli and a splash of vinegar. Fry 2 sliced onions until dark and crisp. Layer lentils, rice, pasta and chickpeas, then top with sauce and onions.

w.n: Book of the Dead honey pastries
w.note: the black Book of the Dead
w.how: Layer buttered filo sheets in a tin with chopped walnuts mixed with cinnamon between every few layers. Cut into diamonds and bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden. Pour over warm honey syrup with lemon juice and leave for several hours to soak.
